title: TREES Reversal Risk Rating Tool
source: ART TREES Reversal Risk Rating Tool

program_governance.label: REDD+ program governance
program_governance.question: Is the REDD+ program mandated by law, policy or another legally binding instrument?

country_governance.label: Country governance
country_governance.question: Average WGI percentile rank across all six indicators, past five years

experience.label: Experience / capacity
experience.question: Has the program received multiple results-based payments or joined a climate finance program before ART?

inclusivity.label: Inclusivity
inclusivity.question: Is there a formal multi-stakeholder committee (incl. IPLCs) giving ongoing input?

disturbance.label: Disturbance impact
disturbance.question: Share of forest in the accounting area hit by natural disturbances over the last 5 years

mitigation.label: Mitigation plans
mitigation.question: Is there a robust system to prevent or limit disturbances (e.g. fire detection and response)?
